title: Ruppelt pressured to debunk his own book

plain: A UFO historian named Richard Dolan, on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about Edward Ruppelt, who wrote a 1950s book called The Report on Unidentified Flying Objects. Dolan says Ruppelt was absolutely pressured, in the late 1950s, to basically debunk his own book. If true, it would mean someone wanted to walk back what an insider had already put in print.
